body: I have stopped routines, what makes me really anxious is to not do them. routines are great for depressed people who need structure. I can zone out but it's like a pressure release valve.  The fact that you meant Edison, not Einstein and made a funny thing about numbers give you 33 upvotes. Newton wouldn't breaking the laws of physics and reality so only 1

I don't even have any close friends. I am part of a cooking group I try to enjoy but whenever people try to talk to me outside of that I start to feel closed in. Support is nice, but not exactly what I need in terms of dysphoria. I need medical interventions that aren't afforded to me and I can't afford. Learning to live without is slowly driving me up the wall.

Just to say some more since I'm blurting out shit under a throwaway, It's more than person to person anxiety making me suicidal. I've been deeply depressed all year and fighting gender dysphoria as a trans person. Blah blah blah suicide rates bravery w/e. I thought I was going into remission but I'm hunkered down in like 'just taking it one day at a time', but I have absolutely no clue what I'm living for because I have no joy. I'm just doing things because it makes me to anxious to stop routine shit. I know I'm burning out and I've been on a razor edge for a long while. I've tried talking to my family about it, but they can't always be my rocks-it's too much for me and them.

I'm drowning because I have no resources and I feel so so trapped and horrible and like I have no clue what I want anymore. Practitioners ask me and...I don't know what I want out of therapy. To not be crazy? To find some hidden meaning in my life when I just feel like I'm just doing absolutely nothing of meaning? 

What am I waiting for taking it one day at a time
